question: Should CodexBar adopt this v11 local cache plus schema-5 Workspaces sidecar as a supported internal foundation before reviewing the separate Workspaces UI integration?
rationale: The branch intentionally establishes durable on-disk formats and public-facing internal fetcher entry points that the follow-up UI will depend on; choosing that long-lived boundary is a maintainer architecture decision.

options.title: Approve the staged foundation
options.body: Accept the v11 cache and SQLite sidecar contract once the exact-head macOS and Linux checks complete successfully, then require the UI follow-up to rebase onto it.

options.title: Defer the storage boundary
options.body: Keep this PR open while maintainers narrow or redesign the durable cache, sidecar, or snapshot API contract before UI work builds on it.

recommendation.title: Approve the staged foundation
recommendation.body: Accept the v11 cache and SQLite sidecar contract once the exact-head macOS and Linux checks complete successfully, then require the UI follow-up to rebase onto it.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership makes this the most likely available decision route, although command-level history verification was unavailable.
